records.title: CFTC Staff Letter 26-05 responding to Coinbase Financial Markets collateral request
records.note: CFTC Market Participants Division reissued its no-action position on February 6, 2026 in response to a request by Coinbase Financial Markets, a CFTC-registered FCM, and similarly registered FCMs. The letter allows an FCM relying on the position to take account of non-security digital assets deemed eligible collateral by a registered DCO/board of trade, subject to the applicable DCO's valuation and haircuts and other segregation, risk and reporting conditions. This is staff no-action relief, not a Commission rule or blanket approval. It creates a conditional legal pathway where a DCO such as Bitnomial accepts XRP; no evidence establishes that Coinbase Financial Markets or Ripple Prime has actually used XRP under this pathway.

records.title: CFTC staff publishes crypto-asset and blockchain activity FAQs
records.note: On March 20, 2026 CFTC Market Participants Division and Division of Clearing and Risk announced FAQs clarifying Staff Letter 25-39 tokenized-collateral guidance and Staff Letter 26-05 digital-assets-accepted-as-margin no-action position. The press release confirms FAQ publication but does not reproduce all FAQ answers.

records.title: The Block analysis of CFTC crypto collateral FAQs
records.note: Secondary reporting on the March 20 CFTC FAQs says DCOs may accept crypto as initial margin for cleared transactions subject to existing credit, market and liquidity risk requirements; DCOs set haircuts subject to monthly review and stress testing; and FCMs relying on Letter 26-05 may expand beyond BTC, ETH and payment stablecoins after their own initial three-month phase. Treat this as secondary legal interpretation pending direct FAQ text review; do not infer universal eligibility.

records.title: PR #1353 exact-head ledger validator failure caused by archive record_type mismatch
records.note: Run 40990012521 on head a27089 compiled successfully and passed 14 tests but failed the current-repository roundtrip test. New shards used xrp_intelligence_archive_shard while scripts/validate_xrp_ledger_index.py requires xrp_research_ledger_archive_shard. The validator code was not defective; newly written archive data violated its schema. Corrected replacement shards are being appended and invalid originals retained unreferenced.
